title: AI palm reading reveal
caption:
We let our AI read a palm. Our tester's reaction: 'Okay, who told it?'

Upload a clear photo of your palm and our AI reads your heart, head, life and fate lines the traditional way, then turns them into a playful personality reading. Your photo is read once and then deleted.

For fun only: a mirror, not a prophecy. No predictions about health, marriage or money, ever.

Would you try it? Comment 'haath' if yes.

Free test: link in bio (mizaj.pk)
